services.heading: Web Application Design & Development
services.text: We design and build digital experiences that matter to your customers.
services.body: Our process-driven approach takes projects from strategy to shipped product quickly: modern frameworks like SvelteKit and TypeScript, a static-first bias for speed, accessibility built in from the start, and content systems your team can actually maintain. Whether it is a marketing site, a web application, or something in between, we build for performance, longevity, and the people who use it.

services.heading: Custom AI Solutions
services.text: We help companies adapt to the AI era, from strategy to shipped software.
services.body: We architect internal tools that make teams faster, customer-facing AI experiences, and bespoke platforms where humans and AI work together, like Replicator, our own brand operating system. The work is grounded in our published research on how language models actually behave, and we open source what we learn, because the best way to keep pace with a shift this large is to build on it.

services.heading: AEO & Agent Readiness
services.text: AI agents are becoming the web's newest audience, and most websites are not ready for them.
services.body: We help organizations get ahead of that shift: auditing sites for agent legibility, implementing the techniques that measurably work (markdown content negotiation, clean semantic content, structured discovery), and skipping the ones that do not. The guidance comes from our own open research program, AEO Bench, where we test agent-readiness techniques against controlled sites and real models before we recommend them, so our clients invest only in what the evidence supports.

services.heading: Custom Software & Apps
services.text: Great ideas deserve software shaped to how your business actually works.
services.body: Non-software companies with strong ideas about digitizing a service or solving a business challenge often need a partner to turn vision into working product. We handle the full arc: scoping the problem, designing the workflows, building the platform, and iterating with your team after launch, so the tool fits the business instead of forcing the business to fit the tool.

services.heading: eCommerce & PIM
services.text: Product data should power your commerce, not hold it back.
services.body: We specialize in PIM, DAM, and MDM implementations and eCommerce transformations built on OpenDXP, one of the most flexible open source unified digital platforms available. From untangling product data spread across spreadsheets and legacy systems to launching storefronts that sell complex offerings, we help you build a single source of truth and put it to work.

services.heading: Sales & Pricing Tools
services.text: Too often, the sales organization is the last to benefit from digital transformation.
services.body: What are the friction points slowing down your sales team or your agents in the call center? Quoting that takes days, pricing that lives in spreadsheets, product knowledge locked in a few veterans' heads. We build the tools that turn that equation around: configurators, pricing engines, and sales portals that let your team answer faster and sell with confidence.

services.heading: Brand Strategy & Voice
services.text: The way customers interact with you is your brand.
services.body: We build brand foundations made for the digital age: positioning, tone of voice, messaging, and content strategy, all designed to survive contact with real channels, real customers, and real interfaces. A brand that only works in a slide deck is not a brand. We craft voices you can actually write in, day after day, across every surface where your customers meet you.

services.heading: UX Optimization
services.text: There is a big gap between usability and great user experience.
services.body: An interface that simply works is table stakes. We help you push past it to experiences that increase affinity, drive sales, and build loyalty: accessibility as a foundation rather than an afterthought, performance customers can feel, and interaction details that respect people's time. Small friction compounds; so does small delight.
